notes:
The row's point is the FACING PAGE: it is in frame, angled, and readable, so OCR will return words from a page nobody meant to import. must_not_import is therefore the interesting half of this row's ground truth and is deliberately left for a person -- it is every word the camera caught from the left-hand page.

This photo is also the evidence behind max_v_drop. It is the only real highlighter on real paper measured so far: paper V 0.800, mark 0.08 below it, which is where the e-reader marks sit on a pure white screen. Without it the fill rule rested entirely on screenshots. Its gutter shadow at 0.77 is a second gift -- saturated, very dark, and correctly rejected by the same rule.
